prompts.pneuma_cuffs_common:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is PNEUMA v5, the EXACT EDIT TARGET.
Input 2 is the user's preferred OUSIA v5 TRANSPARENT logo, reference ONLY for the more accurate SMALL sleeve cuffs and delicate fleur-de-lis ornament treatment. Do NOT copy its short hairstyle, dark vest, or change the white Pneuma outfit.
Input 3 is an actual light/Pneuma model front render, the authority for cuff construction and thin glove edge. Input 4 is actual WHITE glove closeup.
Make ONLY these localized corrections:
1) BOTH sleeve cuffs: current Pneuma cuffs are oversized fantasy shield-like bracers with huge chunky gold curling S-scroll brackets. Replace just those cuff shapes and gold ornaments with model-faithful deep-navy flared fabric cuffs, more compact like preferred Ousia reference. The cuffs are cloth and follow the sleeve/forearm axis, not rigid armor or isolated upright shields. The gold trim is a slender stylized symmetric fleur-de-lis / lyre motif sitting along the cuff's upper folded edge, with a narrow gold outline and modest clean open dark cloth interior. Use actual front render for the gold motif topology. Tone down and narrow the swollen round gold spirals; don't invent a separate giant emblem. Maintain a small blue pleated ruffle between each cuff and glove. No generic white frilly cuffs or changes to upper sleeves.
2) WHITE glove on anatomical LEFT hand / VIEWER RIGHT ONLY: the very thick black border where white fabric meets the bare wrist is wrong. REMOVE that thick BLACK WRIST RING from the WHITE glove. Replace it with a thin pale-grey/lavender seam/edge following the fabric opening, the ordinary thin navy contour appropriate to the rest of the art, with a narrow natural peach wrist visible above it. It is NOT the open black glove's wrist band. Keep the blue TEARDROP centered proximally on WHITE hand, attached at the white glove edge; keep white fabric covering all palm and fingers.
STRICT LOCK: the anatomical RIGHT BLACK glove on VIEWER LEFT already meets user expectations: preserve its skin opening, wrist band, blue teardrop, covered fingers and quill grip EXACTLY. Keep the white hand shape, finger pose and jewel position. Only soften its wrist edge as above. Do not change facial expression, eyes, hair, LONG BACK HAIR, hat/plume, throat pendant, cravat, chest ornaments, WHITE lapels/vest, outer jacket, book, quill, background, framing, padding, dimensions or illustration style. No other repairs or decorations. The actual white/light Pneuma costume still has a blue outer jacket.
Return ONE complete full original-format image with only sleeve cuffs and white glove wrist boundary corrected. Preserve original alpha background / rounded background according to target. No text, annotations, circles, panels or extra objects.
